title: Frozen Test-Set Manifest
description: Authoritative record of one frozen test-set version: every file, its checksum/size, the generator identity, and its cold-archive DOI.

testset_version.description: Frozen version identifier, e.g. 2026.08.1. One DOI per version.

simulation_repo_commit.description: git commit of this repo used to generate

seed_root.description: root PRNG seed; per-dataset seeds derived deterministically

datasets.description: Files belonging to this frozen test set.

uri.description: tier-2 path (gs://) or relative results path

real_source_accessions.description: for real-read datasets: SRA/ENA accessions referenced, not re-hosted

forking.description: Signals for the harness: run all, or only subsets.

doi.description: Zenodo/Dryad DOI for this frozen version

changes_since_previous.description: What changed vs prior frozen version (changelog).
